boards.title: Your First Weekend at California State University-Sacramento, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence mixing campus orientation, creative spaces, recreation, and a Sacramento history stop.

cards.title: Start with a shaded campus walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · north edge of campus
cards.notes: Walk the paths, pause at a bench or picnic table, and use the plant collection to get oriented near the J Street entrance.
cards.short_summary: A calm first look at Sac State’s living plant collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State describes the University Arboretum as a 3.5-acre botanical garden with walking trails, benches, and picnic tables.
cards.source_title: Little-known gems among Sac State's eye-catching landmarks
cards.access_notes: Located near the campus north entrance; check campus conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Make the library your navigation base
cards.subtitle: Late morning · 6000 J Street
cards.notes: Pick up the floor maps, locate a study area, and note the service desk before the first week makes the building feel busier.
cards.short_summary: A practical first-stop for maps, study space, and campus bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library provides floor maps and is located at 6000 J Street on the Sacramento State campus.
cards.access_notes: Library hours vary; consult the library’s current hours page before going inside.

cards.entity_name: Sokiku Nakatani Tea Room and Garden
cards.title: Find the Tea Room and Garden
cards.subtitle: Late morning · University Library
cards.notes: Locate the garden and read up on its tea-gathering program; reserve a future class or gathering only through its official schedule.
cards.short_summary: A library-based cultural space for a quieter campus discovery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sokiku Nakatani Tea Room and Garden hosts tea gatherings, hands-on tea classes, cultural programs, lectures, and special events.
cards.source_title: Sokiku Nakatani Tea Room and Garden
cards.access_notes: Activities are scheduled during the academic year; confirm a gathering or class before planning around it.

cards.title: See what you can make later
cards.subtitle: Early afternoon · Library Room 1529
cards.notes: Take note of the makerspace beside the Carlsen Center, then return with your OneCard when you have a project or workshop in mind.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on library space with digital fabrication and creative tools.
cards.evidence_claim: StingerStudio is in Library Room 1529 and provides maker technologies including 3D printing, digital fabrication, textiles, and virtual reality.
cards.access_notes: Open to current Sacramento State students, faculty, and staff; a OneCard is required.

cards.title: Check the next public show
cards.subtitle: Afternoon · Tschannen Science Complex
cards.notes: Look over the current public-show listing and choose a future show that fits your schedule; bring your OneCard if you are a Sac State student.
cards.short_summary: A campus science venue with public programming and student admission benefits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sacramento State Planetarium offers public shows, and Sacramento State students with a OneCard are admitted free with a ticket.
cards.access_notes: Public-show schedules and tickets change; verify the current listing before traveling to the Planetarium.

cards.title: Learn the campus living room
cards.subtitle: Afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Walk through the Union, find the Info Desk and lounge areas, and save the location for campus resources, food, and future events.
cards.short_summary: A central hub for student services, gathering, and programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State identifies the University Union as a campus-life hub with student services, dining, retail spaces, meeting rooms, and lounge areas.
cards.access_notes: The published building schedule lists Saturday hours of 8 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m.; confirm holiday exceptions.

cards.title: Plan a casual games break
cards.subtitle: Late afternoon · University Union first floor
cards.notes: Find the Games Room and decide whether a future billiards, table-tennis, foosball, or console session suits your group’s pace.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation room with table and video games.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Union Games Room offers billiards tables, console-gaming screens, table tennis, and foosball.
cards.access_notes: Check the Games Room directly for current operating hours, availability, and any required payment or reservation.

cards.title: Tour your recreation options
cards.subtitle: Early evening · campus recreation center
cards.notes: Find the recreation entrance, then choose a future open-recreation, indoor-track, climbing, or fitness-class visit that matches your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: A large recreation and wellness facility with varied student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The WELL offers open recreation, an indoor track, rock climbing for all skill levels, fitness classes, and intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: The published building schedule lists Saturday hours of 8 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; membership or program rules may apply.

cards.title: End the campus loop at the Main Quad
cards.subtitle: Early evening · Main Quad
cards.notes: Use the amphitheatre as a landmark, then check the student-affairs calendar for a future daytime campus program that fits your first term.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Main Quad venue used for campus performances and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State lists the Acorn Amphitheatre in the Main Quad as a location for performances and campus events.
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus landmark; event access and schedules vary by program.

cards.title: Add a Sacramento history stop
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · 2701 L Street, Midtown
cards.notes: Take a self-guided visit through the exhibits, then use the park’s interpretation to place the city and region in wider historical context.
cards.short_summary: A nearby historic site with exhibits and self-guided visiting.
cards.evidence_claim: Sutter's Fort State Historic Park has historic rooms and exhibits, is open daily for self-guided tours, and lists hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours are 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; California State Parks lists adult and youth admission fees, plus closures on major holidays.
